# Server SDK

`supabase-2.118.0.cjs` bundles the official Supabase JS 2.118.0 client for the Node/CommonJS Vercel function loader. It avoids importing the browser ESM artifact from a server function.

Rebuild: `npm run build:server-sdk --prefix shared-sync/tooling` after `npm ci --prefix shared-sync/tooling`.

License: ../../shared-sync/vendor/SUPABASE-LICENSE. No credentials are embedded.
